summary: Mobile Infrastructure Corp filed an 8-K regarding a Fourth Amendment to its Credit Agreement with Harvest Small Cap Partners, L.P. and Harvest Small Cap Partners Master, Ltd. The amendment extends the maturity date from June 30, 2026, to September 30, 2026, and allows lenders to demand cash payment of accrued interest monthly from August 2026. No price, stake, or premium is mentioned. This is a routine debt modification and does not constitute a special situation. The filing is a material definitive agreement and direct financial obligation update, but it is not a trigger event for any special-situation category.
